targetSeconds.title: Target time (seconds)
targetSeconds.description: Players try to stop the clock at exactly this time.

hideAfterSeconds.title: Hide the clock after (seconds)
hideAfterSeconds.description: The running time disappears after this. 0 = never shown; a value at or above the target keeps it visible the whole time.

fullPointsMs.title: Full points within (ms)
fullPointsMs.description: Stops this close to the target (early or late) earn the maximum.

zeroPointsMs.title: No points from (ms off)
zeroPointsMs.description: Stops this far off or more earn 0 points. In between, one point less per equal step.
